scope: After all60 initial sessions, source-bound admission consumer

cases.name: old_guard_positive
cases.test: Original C3 positive remains accepted.

cases.name: new_polygon_correlated_guard
cases.test: Accept the declared coupled polygon with full sensor corners and arbitrary source-admissible pointwise rates/errors. Reject replacing it by its coordinate rectangle: mv=.16625, ma=1.25 produces z2=.08975>R. Preserve the third-coordinate lower barrier after its possible zero crossing.

cases.name: initial_only_escape
cases.test: Reject lower-facet initial entry without positive-delay safety.

cases.name: zero_delay_boundary
cases.test: Distinguish D0 from every positive pending duration.

cases.name: facet_quantifier
cases.test: Reject removal of an individually attained facet because maxima differ.

cases.name: wrong_center
cases.test: Reject changed center labeled original policy.

cases.name: below_center_interval
cases.test: Reject c<U−R by attained upper facet.

cases.name: wrong_radius
cases.test: Reject radius silently reduced without invariant residual proof.

cases.name: weighted_mix
cases.test: Reject substitution of C5 weights/shrink into C3 proof.

cases.name: pending_target
cases.test: Reject target other than−1.21 without recomputing flow.

cases.name: sensor_bound
cases.test: Reject widened sensor box without support recomputation.

cases.name: rate_waveform
cases.test: Support any source-admissible r(t), not only constant endpoint samples.

cases.name: error_placement
cases.test: Keep physical error after clipping.

cases.name: state_reset
cases.test: Reject reset of x/v/a at dispatch.

cases.name: stamp_renewal
cases.test: Keep original timestamp0; startup consumes age.

cases.name: dispatch_sides
cases.test: Check pending left and feedback right atD.

cases.name: slope_binding
cases.test: Require actual continuous-feedback derivative, not command finite differences.

cases.name: tied_active_facets
cases.test: Reject checking only one inward member of a tied active-facet set; another may point outward.

cases.name: clearance_scope
cases.test: Do not infer15cm from translation-invariant entry.

cases.name: existence_scope
cases.test: Separate conditional alltime theorem from constructed execution/detector reachability.
